Read `AGENTS.md`, the approved private Drive `data/about.md` master file, and `jobs/[company]/job.txt`. Create or update only `jobs/[company]/company-info.md` with sourced company, role, market, and interview research. Distinguish verified facts from leads, and do not create applications or change the Master Tracker.
